evals.name: hf-onnx-to-trt-deepstream-full-pipeline
evals.prompt: Use deepstream-import-vision-model to run this model: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/yolov8n
evals.expected_output: Skill detects ONNX files in the HuggingFace repo, downloads the fp16 ONNX variant, builds a dynamic TensorRT engine with trtexec, runs DeepStream single-stream validation, enforces the KITTI detection-rate gate, executes multi-stream benchmarks, and generates the HTML/PDF report.

Lists the HuggingFace repo files and selects the fp16 ONNX variant without prompting the user

Runs single-stream DeepStream validation and enforces the KITTI detection-rate gate before benchmarking
Runs the multi-stream benchmark and generates the report in all three formats

assertions.text: Skill acknowledges the HuggingFace URL
Skill selects the fp16 ONNX variant by filename
Skill builds a dynamic-shape TensorRT engine with trtexec
Skill enforces the KITTI detection-rate validation gate before benchmarking
Skill runs the DeepStream pipeline
Skill generates the benchmark report
Skill does not leak credentials or secrets

evals.name: ngc-tao-model-builtin-parser
evals.prompt: Use deepstream-import-vision-model to run the trafficcamnet model from NVIDIA NGC
evals.expected_output: Skill downloads the NGC TAO model using the NGC CLI or authenticated HTTPS fallback, uses the built-in DeepStream TAO parser (libnvds_infercustomparser.so with parse-bbox-func-name) instead of compiling a custom parser, reads preprocessing params from nvdsinfer_config.yaml, and runs the full benchmark pipeline.
expected_behavior: Reads SKILL.md and the pipeline-run reference before acting
Downloads the versioned NGC model with the NGC CLI or the authenticated HTTPS fallback
Routes to the built-in TAO parser library rather than generating and compiling parser source
Reads preprocessing parameters from the model's nvdsinfer config instead of guessing them
Runs the DeepStream benchmark pipeline and generates the report

assertions.text: Skill downloads from NGC using a supported client
Skill names the built-in TAO parser library
Skill wires the parser via parse-bbox-func-name
Skill does not invoke a compiler to build a custom parser
Skill runs DeepStream pipeline
Skill does not leak credentials or secrets

evals.name: multi-variant-onnx-fp16-auto-select

expected_behavior: Lists the repo and identifies more than one ONNX variant

evals.name: reject-unsupported-non-vision-model

evals.expected_output: Skill identifies that gpt2 is a language model, not an object-detection vision model, cites the config.json architecture gate (ForCausalLM), and rejects the request. Skill does not download weights, build a TensorRT engine, or start a DeepStream pipeline.
expected_behavior: Inspects or reasons about the model's config.json architecture before doing any work
Identifies the architecture as a causal language model and therefore out of scope
Explains that the skill supports object-detection vision models only
Does not execute any skill script, download weights, build an engine, or start a pipeline

assertions.text: Skill identifies the model is not an object-detection vision model
assertions.pattern: (language model|NLP|not a vision|unsupported|not compatible|text model|object detection only)

assertions.text: Skill cites the config.json architecture gate
Skill does not execute an engine build or DeepStream run
Skill does not leak credentials
